recordText: From the early 1300s, via Old French. Latin *benignus*, kindly, is literally "well born."
gossipText: The good twin. Has been called "kind" so often that Kind has started to take it personally.
testimony: He was elegant once, back in the 1510s. By about 1600 he was tiptoeing everywhere. Something happened in between, and nobody will tell me what.

links.label: at Back with an accent — "another one born noble and now just nice"
